description: Name ideas for a cleaning business, optionally built around a city and a keyword (the owner’s name, a word they like), in one of five styles. Check each name with the state business registry and for a free domain before using it.

city.description: City or area the business serves.

keyword.description: A word to build names around, such as the owner’s name.

style.description: classic (Classic and trustworthy), friendly (Friendly and local), premium (Premium and polished), eco (Green and eco-friendly), playful (Playful and memorable). Default friendly.

variant.description: Ask again with a higher number for a different set.

name: cleaning_business_names
title: Cleaning business name ideas
